title: Memo summarizer note output v1
description: Structured output of the memo summarizer for one highlight thread: a short learning note summarizing the highlighted text and the conversation about it. Recorded as a memo.recorded v1 payload: 'title' and 'body' are copied verbatim; the harness adds memo_id, highlight_id, thread_id, source_event_ids and provenance. Input: the highlight (selected_text + context + source) and every chat message of the thread so far. The reference solution is never in the summarizer context during an unfinished attempt (same rule as the tutor, AC-J6).
